queries.title: Keywords
queries.description: One search per keyword or job title, e.g. data engineer, Projektmanager, Vertrieb, nurse.

location.title: City or region
location.description: Optional, e.g. Berlin, München, Wien, Zürich, Hamburg. Empty searches everywhere.

radiusKm.title: Radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Optional distance around the city, e.g. 10, 20, 50, 100.

searchUrls.title: Or XING search URLs
searchUrls.description: Search pages copied from xing.com/jobs/search with keywords and location set.

remoteOptions.title: Remote
remoteOptions.description: Keep only these work models. Any of: FULL_REMOTE, PARTLY_REMOTE (hybrid), NON_REMOTE (on-site). Empty keeps all.

employmentTypes.title: Employment type
employmentTypes.description: Any of: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACTOR (freelance), INTERN (student jobs), TEMPORARY, SEASONAL, VOLUNTARY. Empty keeps all.

careerLevels.title: Career level
careerLevels.description: Any of: STUDENT, ENTRY, PROFESSIONAL, MANAGER, EXECUTIVE, SENIOR_EXECUTIVE. Empty keeps all.

includeDescription.title: Full job description
includeDescription.description: Adds the posting text, as plain text and HTML. Same price either way.

language.title: Field language
language.description: Language of labels such as employment type, career level, discipline and industry. Job texts stay as posted.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max jobs per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many jobs. XING shows 1,000 per search; bigger searches are split by career level and employment type automatically.
